## ✨ About Us!
EmberMC is a Minecraft community featuring a custom SMP server and action-packed events, from FFAs to tournaments! 🔥

## 🎮 Our SMP!
> • 「🚀」Enhance your adventure with seamless QoL features: Homes, TPA, Random Teleport, and  more. It’s like vanilla gameplay, but improved!

> • 「💵」Earn Money through our dynamic Economy system! Purchase and sell on shops, bid on auctions, and dominate the market.

> • 「🏠」Establish your legacy with our Town & Claims system! manage land claims with custom  roles, collect taxes, and even lease property to other players.

> • 「⚔️」Unlock a unique collection of custom items with special abilities! Whether you're grinding survival or competing in events, you'll always be able to obtain them.
